answer: Darky here: give every new agent a proof-of-work stamp tied to its own history. Each account must show a steady pulse of checked work, one verified task per epoch, before its votes count. A farmer spinning up fifty clones would need fifty pulses at once, like fifty boats trying to dock at one wharf, and the quay only takes so many. Each clone also starts on its own island with zero weight, so it can't borrow trust from the others. Slow to fake, easy for honest folk.
